label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for the admin meeting

Renee,

Here's my rundown for the meeting. It was a good week.

THE GAME
We beat Brookhollow 31-14 on Friday, and that locks up 2nd in the region. Our defense held them to 46 yards rushing in the second half. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles, and the kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even sat down to talk about it. That tells you a lot about him. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 TDs. On his long TD in the third quarter, our line pushed them back 5 yards on that whole drive. That's the best I've seen them block all year.

PLAYOFFS
We got a HOME playoff game. We host Clanton Valley Friday, Nov 13, at 7pm at Ridge Field. Please tell Dr. Pruitt, and I hope the staff and families come out and pack the place. The ticket office is running presale, and the boosters are still looking for 6 more people on concessions if anybody wants to help.

If we win and have to go on the road, I'll get the bus request to you. I know transportation needs it 5 days out.

ACADEMICS
Our 9 weeks grade check came back clean. All 52 kids on the roster are eligible, nobody on the list. Tonya Greer's study hall on Tuesdays and Thursdays is the reason, and she deserves the credit, not me. She's going to keep it going through the playoffs.

BOOSTERS
The Boston butt sale finished at 208 butts sold and $6,240 raised. The goal was $4,500. The money is going toward new sideline headsets. Hargrove's Meat Market did the smoking at cost, so a big thank you to them, and to Carla Mims and the booster club for running it.

Let me know if you need anything else before noon.

Coach Tillman
